D/ IMP [---] (LICINIV?)S P F AVG ; R/ [IOVI CONS]ERVATORI

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Licinius I (308-324), dating to AD 321-4 (Reece Period 16), IOVI CONSERVATORI, Jupiter standing left, holding Victory and sceptre, between eagle and captive. Probably Mint of Cyzicus. RIC VII, p. 645, cf. no. 15. Obverse description: Radiate bust right, probably bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP [---] (LICINIV?)S P F AVG. Reverse description: Jupiter…
